name: claude-garage
description: Multiple Claude agents driving you crazy? Park them all in one garage: a full-screen terminal wall with a needs-input queue that follows you across projects. tmux owns the sessions; close the app and nothing dies.
author: Saiful Islam <saifulislamadar@gmail.com>

scripts.test:contract:rust: cargo build -p claude-garage && GARAGE_DAEMON_CMD="${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-$PWD/target}/debug/claude-garage daemon" cargo test --manifest-path tests/contract/Cargo.toml
scripts.build:plugins: cargo build --release --workspace && sh scripts/stage-plugins.sh release wall/dist/plugins
scripts.build:tui: cargo build --release -p garage-wall && mkdir -p wall/dist && rm -f wall/dist/garage-wall-$(node -p "process.platform+'-'+process.arch") && cp target/release/garage-wall wall/dist/garage-wall-$(node -p "process.platform+'-'+process.arch")
